chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 555: The Real Hell of the Great Qi - A Heartbreaking Encounter
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang confronts the true cost of the Heavenly Calamity when he meets a single, silent orphan in the ruins of a crushed village. A devastating chapter on the limits of power and the nature of reality.
og_title: The Great Qi's True Horror: A Child Beneath a Broken Mountain
og_description: A heartbreaking encounter forces Li Huowang to see the human tragedy of the Great Qi, challenging what he can and cannot save.
twitter_title: The Great Qi is a Hell You Can't Escape
twitter_description: Li Huowang finds a mute orphan in a collapsed village and learns the cruelest rule of the Dao-Twisted World: you can't save someone from the real world if you live in a fake one.

lore_anchors.definition: A small shrine dedicated to the local tutelary deities, the Earth God and Goddess, who protect a specific village or area. In the Dao-Twisted World, these shrines often harbor corrupted or merged forms of these once-benevolent spirits.
A Daoist ritual writing on paper used for a variety of purposes, from warding off evil to summoning aid. Li Huowang uses a golden one here at Zhuge Yuan’s direction to call an ally.
A specific dimensional portal or landmark used for transit between the Great Liang and the Great Qi. Reaching it requires precise navigation of the world's corrupted metaphysical geography.
The ghostly scholar from the Great Liang who guides Li Huowang. He possesses profound knowledge of geomancy and ritual, and is Li Huowang's most trusted, rational advisor—even in death.
The parasitic entity (Black Tai Sui) living inside Li Huowang, who he treats as a daughter. She possesses tentacles and a child-like consciousness, often wanting meat and calling Li Huowang 'Dad.'
The "real" world in the Dao-Twisted dichotomy, a land ravaged by Heavenly Calamities and where the laws of reality are breaking down. Its inhabitants cannot cross into the "fake" Great Liang.
The "fake" world where Li Huowang's group primarily operates. It is a synthetic reality that can access the Great Qi, but the reverse is impossible, creating a one-way trap of suffering.
